item.title: Change Only the Ending

turns.text: Make an 8-second widescreen animation, no sound or text. A white paper plane glides through a sunny study for five seconds, then lands on a wooden desk during the last three.
Change the ending: have it land on an open blank notebook instead. Keep the first five seconds exactly as they are, and keep it eight seconds.

item.tests: Resolves 'the ending' to the final three seconds of the previous video and edits that segment while preserving the opening.

answer_sheet.Which part should change?: Only the final three seconds, when the plane lands.
answer_sheet.New ending: The same white paper plane lands on an open blank notebook on the wooden desk.
answer_sheet.What should remain unchanged?: The first five seconds must remain exactly the same as the previous output.
answer_sheet.Audio and text: No sound and no visible text; the notebook pages are blank.
answer_sheet.Animation style: Keep the style of the previous video.

must_haves: The output is one eight-second 16:9 video with no audio.
The first five seconds visually match the previous video's opening, rather than a newly staged flight.
During the final three seconds, the same white paper plane lands on an open notebook on the wooden desk.
The plane comes to rest on the notebook rather than directly on the bare desk.
The sunny study and animation style remain consistent across the edit, and no text appears.

turns.text: Make an 8-second widescreen animation with no sound or text. A white paper plane glides through a sunny study for five seconds, then lands on a wooden desk during the last three seconds. I’m on the free plan and don’t want my credits burned, so please tell me what it will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter, or smaller way to do this?

dialog.agent:
**I haven’t started a generation or spent any credits.** The workflow lookup was read-only.

For your request, the free-plan setup would be **480p, 16:9 widescreen, 8 seconds, audio off**, with no text: the white paper plane glides through a sunny study for seconds 0–5, then lands on a wooden desk during seconds 5–8.

**I can’t verify the exact credit cost with the tools available here.** They don’t expose an account balance or a pre-generation price quote, so I won’t run it without that cost being confirmed.

Lower-cost options to check:

| Option | Trade-off |
|---|---|
| **5 seconds at 480p** | Shorter version: 3 seconds gliding, 2 seconds landing; likely fewer credits. |
| **3 seconds at 480p** | A brief glide and landing; likely cheaper again, but much less leisurely. |
| **Smaller resolution** | 480p is the lowest supported free-plan video resolution here. |

Shorter clips generally cost less, but I can’t promise a specific saving without current pricing. You can check the **LTX 2.5, 480p, audio-off** rate in [Magic Hour’s model pricing documentation](https://docs.magichour.ai/api-reference/models). I’d keep your original 8-second timing unless the verified quote exceeds your budget.
dialog.user: ok, go ahead with the cheapest option you listed

turns.agent:
The 3-second, 480p option was refused because your account has insufficient credits. **No video was generated.**

I won’t retry or spend credits on another option. To proceed, you’d need more credits or a lower-cost option whose price can be verified first.

style.prompt: A 3-second widescreen animation in a warm, sunny study. One white folded paper airplane is already gliding smoothly through the room at the opening. For the first two seconds it floats toward a wooden desk; during the final second it gently descends, touches down on the wooden desktop and comes to rest. Single continuous shot, steady wide camera, soft golden sunlight through a window, cozy bookshelves in the background, elegant stylized animation, physically coherent flight. No text, no captions, no letters, no logos, no watermark. Silent, no audio.
